description:
Get full details of a specific network request by its requestId.
Returns request/response headers (sensitive headers redacted), status, timing, the request body, and optionally the response body.
Request and response bodies over 1000 chars are cut to 1000 under a "[TRUNCATED: ...]" line that gives the full size; a binary response body is omitted. Use when you need headers, body, or timing for a specific request after listing logs.
Returns an error message string if the requestId is not found.

device_id.description: Device id from list-devices (iOS simulator UDID or Android serial), the same id used with debugger-connect. An android- ID needs no debugger connection.

includeBody.description: Whether to include the response body (if captured). Default: true.

port.description: Metro port. Omit it to use this device's port (8081 by default). Ignored for Chromium, whose CDP port is in device_id. Range: 1 to 65535.

requestId.description: The requestId from view-network-logs, or an android- ID from native-network-logs.

name: view-network-request-details
